tasks.analysis: One of the topics psychologists investigate is our capacity to understand the mental states of others. This ability is fundamental for social interaction because it enables us to predict and explain the behavior of others. Is this skill innate or shaped by experience? Is understanding others’ mental states a matter of simulation (imagining ourselves in their place) or theory (applying a set of rules or concepts)? These inquiries contribute to broader discussions about human cognition. 心理学家研究的课题之一，是我们理解他人心理状态的能力。这种能力是社交互动的基础，因为它让我们能够预测和解释他人的行为。这种能力是与生俱来的，还是由后天经验塑造的？理解他人的心理状态，是依靠共情模拟（设身处地想象自己处于对方的处境），还是依靠理论推理（运用一系列规则或概念进行判断）？这些探究推动了关于人类认知的更广泛讨论。
